event.name: AUTOwn'26
event.theme: Connecting Industry Innovation with Intelligent Automotive Excellence
event.tagline: Project & Poster Presentations | Competitions | Technical Workshops
event.registration_notice: Registrations are open on Zoho Backstage. Last date will be announced soon.
event.organiser: BITS Pilani – Work Integrated Learning Programmes (WILP)

vision.text: To connect academia and industry in advancing intelligent automotive technologies, bringing together innovation in autonomous systems, AI and machine learning, automotive cybersecurity, electric and hybrid vehicles, embedded systems, automotive communication, software-defined vehicles, and allied domains.

objectives.title: Innovation & Research
objectives.text: Encourage innovation and research across the AUTOwn'26 project and paper presentation tracks.

objectives.title: Real-World Impact
objectives.text: Connect academic work with real-world automotive and mobility challenges.

objectives.title: Hands-on Learning
objectives.text: Promote hands-on learning through technical competitions and industry-oriented workshops.

objectives.title: Collaboration
objectives.text: Create opportunities for students, researchers, and professionals to exchange ideas and collaborate.

about.text: AUTOwn'26 brings together students, researchers, academicians, and industry professionals to explore the technologies shaping next-generation vehicles. Through project and paper presentations, competitions, and technical workshops, the event highlights innovation across intelligent, connected, secure, and software-driven automotive systems.
about.who_should_attend: Engineering students and teams, researchers, academicians, working professionals, automotive and embedded engineers, cybersecurity practitioners, AI/ML developers, robotics enthusiasts, startups, and innovators working in automotive and allied domains.

highlights.text: Project and paper presentations across eight automotive technology tracks.
Technical competitions: Autonomous Mini Car Racing, Embedded Systems Hackathon, HackArena CTF and VR Simulator for Autonomous Vehicles.
Proposed technical workshops in autonomous systems, automotive cybersecurity, robotics, AUTOSAR/automotive software, and model-based design.
Industry–academia interaction and a combined prize pool of ₹4,00,000.
Panel Discussions & Expert Talks: insights from industry experts through engaging panel discussions and technical sessions.

tracks.title: Autonomous Systems
tracks.text: Autonomous navigation, perception, sensor fusion, path planning, vehicle control, and collision avoidance.

tracks.title: AI & Machine Learning
tracks.text: AI-based perception, driver assistance, predictive maintenance, edge AI, and intelligent automotive decision-making.

tracks.title: Automotive Cybersecurity
tracks.text: Security of ECUs, in-vehicle networks, connected vehicles, V2X systems, and EV charging infrastructure.

tracks.title: Electric & Hybrid Vehicles
tracks.text: Battery management, energy optimisation, charging systems, regenerative braking, and EV safety.

tracks.title: Automotive & Allied Domain
tracks.text: Vehicle dynamics, driver and occupant safety, robotics, smart infrastructure, manufacturing, and related engineering.

tracks.title: Software-Defined Vehicles
tracks.text: Vehicle software architecture, zonal ECUs, over-the-air updates, virtual ECUs, and software validation.

tracks.title: Automotive Embedded Systems
tracks.text: Embedded Systems for Next-Generation Vehicles: real-time embedded control, automotive ECUs, AUTOSAR, microcontrollers, diagnostics, and hardware–software integration.

tracks.title: Automotive Communication
tracks.text: Real-Time AI Inference at the Vehicle/Edge, Real-Time Communication, and Energy-Efficient AI Accelerators: Automotive Ethernet, low-latency networking, V2X, edge AI inference, communication-aware scheduling, and energy-efficient AI acceleration.

events.title: Autonomous Mini Car Racing
events.text: Design and program mini cars to navigate a defined track using sensing, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and embedded control.

events.title: Embedded Systems Hackathon
events.text: Build a working embedded solution through a time-bound hardware–software challenge.

events.title: HackArena CTF: Capture the Flag
events.text: Solve cybersecurity challenges involving areas such as network security, cryptography, vulnerability analysis, and secure systems in an authorised environment.

events.title: VR Simulator for Autonomous Vehicles
events.text: Build a VR simulator to safely train and test autonomous vehicles before real-world deployment.

events.title: Project & Poster Presentation
events.text: Showcase your project or poster under any of the eight AUTOwn'26 tracks.

events.title: Paper Presentation
events.text: Present a paper under any of the eight AUTOwn'26 tracks.

events.title: Drone / Autonomous Systems Workshop
events.text: Introduction to drone systems, sensing, navigation, flight control, and autonomous applications.

events.title: Automotive Cybersecurity Workshop
events.text: Threat modelling and security approaches for ECUs, in-vehicle networks, and connected vehicles.

Competitions: ₹1,500 per team. Project and Paper Presentations: ₹1,000 per team. Workshops: ₹500 per individual participant.

faqs.q: Which tracks can I submit a project or paper under?
faqs.a: Autonomous Systems, AI & Machine Learning, Automotive Cybersecurity, Electric & Hybrid Vehicles, Automotive & Allied Domain, Software-Defined Vehicles, Automotive Embedded Systems, and Automotive Communication. Detailed submission guidelines will be issued separately.
Pre-event technical workshops are on Friday, 12 February 2027, with further workshops on both main event days.
Click Register, pick Competitions, Workshop or Attendee, choose your event, and complete your registration and payment on Zoho Backstage.

faqs.q: Whom do I contact for questions?
faqs.a: Write to bitswilpautown@wilp.bits-pilani.ac.in or call the coordinators, Prof. Rakesh Chandra Dash (8249073596) and Prof. Niranjan Raj (8256916189). Coordinator contacts for your track, competition or workshop are shared after registration.
